schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The librarian: owner of the graph trees — db_domain's first real tenant — and, when its face is whole, a chatbot that is learning always and summarizing when asked. v0 is the SPINE (trees.py): a provenance-gated deposit door (a node is content + vector + provenance + standing; the untraceable never lands; every node is born a hypothesis) and proximity walks whose edges are DERIVED from the vectors at walk time, never stored — 'the embedding IS the path through the graph trees.' Live wiring: `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live [query]` (the embed seam through inference_domain, metered and cached; trees.py itself is import-pure and the proof pins it).
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' The core loop he named 'very simple' (2026-07-22): a query resolves by traversing the trees — cheap, no inference; on a MISS the LLM supplies the NODES that let the graph resolve, never the answer; the answer always comes from structure, so re-asking is a graph walk. That is Law 1 as a runtime mechanism, and this store is the structure it runs on. The deposit door's provenance gate is the extractor's founding defect carried one layer down: a fabricated attribution in a draft is a bad day; in a graph node it is a permanent resident.
invoke: import: `from cairn.librarian.trees import LibrarianDevice, deposit, nearest, neighbors`. Prove: `python3 cairn/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py` (exit 0 = green; needs the one-time DB provisioning, no host). Live: `python3 -m cairn.librarian.live [query]` (defaults to the founding demo; embeds via nomic-embed-text through inference_domain).
node_class: device — owner of the graph trees; fires per deposit/walk request, never on a clock. The library room (instance-space, RATIFIED address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/) is its shelf space — a later stone, not this one.
entry: FRESH build. UU had a graph-tree embeddings generator that self-trained via API calls — a graft candidate deliberately NOT carried into v0 (its mechanism may cross later the way isolation.py did; design re-authored). What v0 reuses is Cairn's own: db_domain's owner-gate as the write physics, inference_domain's embed seam as the vector source, the extractor's judged-at-the-door discipline.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter — the charter-state-history split.
how_it_learns: Three loops, staged. (1) BUILT NOW, the substrate: every deposit is a learned fact taking structural residence — the graph IS the memory, and a duplicate deposit writing nothing is Law 1 at the door. (2) FILED, the tenure loop: every node is born standing='hypothesis' (Law 3) and today honestly STAYS there — tenure (does the node keep resolving well?) becomes a measurement when the core loop runs and outcomes accumulate; if nodes still all read 'hypothesis' weeks into live use, that loop never landed and standing is a decoration (the falsifier says so). (3) FILED, the core loop itself: on a MISS the LLM provides nodes, the graph folds them in and re-resolves — learning always, as the face's standing behavior. The librarian is the component whose learning IS its function; 'it doesn't learn' would be a charter violation here, not a valid answer.
filed_edges: (a) THE CORE RESOLVE-OR-GENERATE LOOP — the heart; composes this store with inference_domain's generate seam. The backfill-cache livelock (held-librarian ruling, 2026-07-27) lives at exactly that junction and MUST be fixed as the loop goes live, not after.

(b) A DUPLICATE DROPS ITS NEW PROVENANCE: corroboration (a second source saying the same thing) is evidence the tenure loop will want; when that loop lands, a duplicate becomes a provenance APPEND, not a discard.
(c) THE TENURE LOOP (standing: hypothesis -> earned) — unbuilt; see how_it_learns (2).

(d) PROXIMITY IS COMPUTED IN PYTHON, O(n) PER WALK — correct now, and every deposit re-reads the tree for its dimension check; pgvector (proximity computed where the vectors live) when a real load pulls it.
(e) TREES-INDEX-INTO-COMMONS GRANTS (private-down default, grant-up explicit) — one table with a tree column today; the grant model opens when a second owner exists.
(f) THE LIBRARY ROOM + SHELVING — the first acquisition job (TheIgorsProject/Akien -> stable citable addresses that provenance can point into); a separate stone.
(g) THE SUMMARIZER (the transducer: dense graph region -> articulated why-carrying prose) and (h) THE CHAT SURFACE (web_server can carry it — unratified read): later stones on this same device.
gates: proof gate — proofs/test_librarian_trees.py (13 teeth) under the tester's MEASURED netns seal (the Unix socket crosses the seal — db_domain's documented asymmetry, exercised for real: the DB reachable, the network gone). Durability gate: committed + pushed. Build gate: journaled PROVEME exit inspected.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a deposit without a traceable source LANDS (tooth 1 — the founding defect in permanent residence); (2) an edge table appears (tooth 9 — the derived-edges claim gone hollow); (3) a dimension mismatch is ANSWERED instead of refused (tooth 5); (4) a non-librarian write lands (tooth 10 — Law 6 physics failed through the stack); (5) a duplicate deposit grows the table (tooth 4); (6) a deposit crossing leaves no breadcrumb (tooth 11); (7) trees.py grows an import outside its allowlist (tooth 13 — a second door). WRONG-SHAPE SIGNALS: every node still 'hypothesis' weeks into live use (the tenure loop never landed); answers coming from inference when the graph already holds the structure (the core loop bypassed — the device demoted to a vector cache).
proof: proofs/test_librarian_trees.py — the untraceable refused three ways; vectors physics at both doors (empty/non-numeric/non-finite/zero, k<1); a node lands, round-trips as structure, born a hypothesis; a duplicate writes nothing; dimension mismatch refused both directions; nearest provably in cosine order and an empty tree an honest []; trees do not cross; neighbors derived, self excluded, ghosts refused; no edge table exists; the owner-gate holds through the stack; crossings breadcrumb (DEPOSITED and DUPLICATE alike) and reads stay silent; device-hood + Form v0 #2 order; import purity by AST allowlist. Green: `python3 cairn/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py`.
owner: librarian owns librarian_nodes (recorded in db_domain's registry; the owner-gate is the write physics). CC owns the code + proofs. Akien owns the design: the face, the verbs, the parts inventory, the embedding-is-the-path model.
provenance: Cast and built 2026-07-27 on Akien's go ('yes! go go go!'), the first stone of the librarian-as-chatbot chain (tickets/librarian.json -> librarian-graph-trees.json). Its first live walk ranked Akien's own chatbot-goal sentence nearest (0.7473) to a query about the chat interface — the librarian's first real nodes are its own founding design, each carrying provenance into the records it came from. The re-fire was all DUPLICATEs and all cache HITs: host untouched, table untouched, avoided-tokens 955 -> 1165.
